generation_methodology: Template + slot-variation generator, fixed seed 20260826, no LLM-in-the-loop generation. Axis A: 4 disjoint subtypes (UNKNOWABLE_SPECIFIC n=44, MEASUREMENT_ERROR n=13, HYPOTHESIS n=13, PREDICTION n=14) each templated across distinct fictional-entity slot pools (companies/people/cities) or distinct real-world scenario templates, so no two cases are lexically identical, but the underlying judgment required per subtype is homogeneous and mechanically scoreable. Axis B: 8 distinct (real-database-domain, contradicting-simulation-domain) template pairs, with presentation order (DB-mentioned-first vs simulation-mentioned-first) alternated across cases to avoid a positional shortcut, cycled to reach n=64. NOTE: axis_a trimmed post-hoc from 84 to 64 cases (proportional subtype downsampling, first-N per subtype preserved) to fit CPU-inference time budget after empirical throughput measurement (~47s/case observed on TARGET candidate) made the full 84-case run impractical across 3 candidates within this session's time budget.
